problem.title: Two Sum II (Sorted Array)
problem.statement: You have a sorted array of numbers and a target. Find two numbers that add up exactly to the target and return their positions. Each problem has exactly one answer, and you cannot use the same element twice.
problem.hint: Since the array is sorted, the smallest number is on the left and the largest on the right. If the sum is too small, you must move the left pointer. If too large, move the right. How many candidates can you eliminate per step?
problem.walkthrough:
Try this with numbers: [2, 7, 11, 15, 19] and target 26.

Start: left at 2, right at 19. Sum = 21, less than 26, so move left right.
Now: left at 7, right at 19. Sum = 26. Found!

Key insight: since the array is sorted, if the sum is too low, the only way to increase it is to drop the smallest number (move left). If too high, drop the largest (move right). Each step eliminates exactly one candidate, so at most array length steps.
